svg.title: Five-Sensor Array
svg.desc: A branded RoboLore instructional graphic showing the five-sensor proximity array with sensor positions 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5 highlighted on the board.
svg.text: positions 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5 installed across the front sensor board
This configuration uses every front sensor position
to create the highest-resolution obstacle coverage.
All five positions are populated in the 5-sensor array
The highlighted modules span the full front edge of the array, giving the robot continuous left-to-right sensing coverage.
Watches the outer right side of the robot’s forward detection zone.
Adds coverage between the right edge and the centerline.
Looks directly in front of the robot and anchors the array.
Covers the area between the centerline and the far-left edge.
Monitors the outer left side and completes the full spread.
Using all five positions maximizes front sensing detail and helps the robot distinguish obstacle location more precisely.
